car_detailing.title: Independent car-detailing business-contact review
car_detailing.hypothesis: A published Maps number for an independent, core car-detailing business can begin a business-contact workflow. Neither a mobile-detailing claim, a Maps phone, nor an SOS agent/officer establishes business ownership, ownership of a handset, or permission to contact a person.
car_detailing.ownerSource: No owner-confirming detailing source is implemented. The catalog's SOS-plus-Maps suggestion supplies only a role-labeled agent or officer candidate after a business match and must not be used for personal-phone or address enrichment.
car_detailing.phoneSource: Implemented recipe-A Maps discovery for the car-detailing keyword; the published number remains a business-contact candidate until the existing line, live, DNC/TCPA, suppression, and duplicate gates pass.

workflow.label: Discover published car-detailing business
workflow.detail: Start with the live recipe-A Maps route. A listing and advertised number are business evidence only.

workflow.label: Core detailing fit?
workflow.detail: Require detailing, detail, ceramic coating, paint correction, or mobile-detailing evidence. Car wash, tint, wrap, and auto-repair-only results do not prove a detailing business.

workflow.label: Hold adjacent or ambiguous result
workflow.detail: Do not relabel a car wash, tint/wrap, repair shop, dealer, or generic automotive listing as detailing without core detailing evidence.

workflow.label: Independent operator segment?
workflow.detail: Keep franchise, chain, and multi-location listings out of the owner-candidate branch pending a separately reviewed workflow.

workflow.label: Hold brand or multi-location listing
workflow.detail: A branded local outlet can be a business contact but is not an owner-confirmed contact from its brand pattern.

workflow.label: Published business number present?
workflow.detail: Do not infer a person phone from a mobile-service claim, agent/officer name, business address, or a different public listing number.

workflow.label: Hold missing business contact
workflow.detail: Keep an identity candidate without a published business number out of phone processing.

workflow.label: Business-contact gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression, and duplicate checks on the published number. These do not prove ownership of the business or handset.

workflow.label: Hold failed contact gate
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, or otherwise unverified rows.

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?
workflow.detail: A matched SOS agent/officer, a business name, a mobile line, or a review mention alone is insufficient. Preserve any role as candidate evidence only.

workflow.label: Hold as business contact
workflow.detail: Do not label or deliver an owner-confirmed mobile without separately recorded ownership and handset evidence.

workflow.label: Deliver approved owner-confirmed contact
workflow.detail: Only a future workflow that records independent owner evidence and every contact/compliance gate may use this classification.

failures.mitigation: Move car wash from the detailing core list to adjacent (or remove it), then require a detail/ceramic/paint-correction/mobile-detailing signal before the car-detailing route continues.

failures.risk: Tint, wrap, PPF, auto-repair, dealer, or car-wash-only listings are described as detailing businesses.
failures.mitigation: Hold adjacent-only listings until a core detailing signal is present; do not treat the brain allow pattern as owner or relevance proof.

failures.risk: A mobile-detailing advertisement is described as a direct owner cell.
failures.mitigation: Treat the Maps number as a published business contact and retain mobile/service claims as unverified; require line, live, DNC/TCPA, suppression, dedupe, owner, and handset gates.

failures.risk: An SOS agent or officer is represented as the owner, or a filing address is used to find a personal phone.
failures.mitigation: Use any SOS role only as matched identity-candidate evidence, prohibit address/person-phone enrichment, and require independent ownership and handset evidence.

failures.risk: A detailing franchise or multi-location brand is treated as a one-person operator.
failures.mitigation: Segment known automotive brands and hold franchise/multi-location matches before forming an owner hypothesis.

The actual extract has no phone field, so a separately published business number is required; neither the Qualifier nor that number establishes a confirmed owner or direct owner mobile.
contractor_fl.ownerSource: FL DBPR CONSTRUCTIONLICENSE_1.csv and lic08el.csv provide an active, unexpired licensee parsed as a Qualifier candidate, with DBA, class code, and business address context. Qualifier is a license role, not owner confirmation.
contractor_fl.phoneSource: The DBPR adapter has no phone column. Recipe D obtains a separately published Maps business contact for the register row's city; it remains a business-contact candidate until match, line-type, live, DNC, dedupe, and independent owner-evidence gates pass.

workflow.detail: Read a construction or electrical extract row only when primary status is C, secondary status is blank or A, and expiration is in the future.

workflow.label: Hold inactive or incomplete record
workflow.detail: Do not route expired, non-current, secondary-inactive, malformed, or non-person licensee rows as a person candidate.

workflow.label: Qualifier candidate assessment
workflow.detail: Preserve the source title Qualifier and class code. Do not promote a qualifier to owner based only on the license record or DBA.

workflow.label: Published business-contact contrast
workflow.detail: Recipe D discovers contractor listings in register-derived cities and compares a credible business match; the register itself contributes no phone.

workflow.label: Hold absent or weak business match
workflow.detail: Keep the DBPR identity for review, but do not infer a number or person-phone edge from city, DBA, address, or a non-match.

workflow.label: Contact and ownership evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require the existing mobile line-type, live, DNC, suppression/dedupe, and independent owner-evidence checks; a business listing is not owner proof.

workflow.label: Hold business-only or failed contact
workflow.detail: Park office, non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, shared, or qualifier-only cases.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after every contact and owner-evidence gate passes. No DBPR qualifier alone is an owner-confirmed mobile.

contractor_mn.title: Minnesota contractors: Master-license identity with contact safeguards
contractor_mn.hypothesis: MN DLI Electrical and Plumbing Master-level, Issued license rows can establish a license-role and published business-contact candidate. A Personal licensee, a Business row, and a register phone do not independently establish business ownership, handset ownership, mobile line type, or permission to contact a person.
contractor_mn.ownerSource: MN DLI Licensee Name on a Personal Master-level license is a named license-role candidate only. Business rows have no named person, and neither row type independently confirms ownership.
contractor_mn.phoneSource: MN DLI Phone_No is a published business-contact candidate. The catalog reports reuse up to 189 licenses, so it cannot be treated as a direct or exclusive owner phone without a distinct-business/person reuse gate and all downstream contact gates.

workflow.detail: Do not use expired, non-Issued, unsupported-class, or malformed-date rows as contractor candidates.

workflow.label: License role classification

workflow.label: Hold business-only owner claim
workflow.detail: Keep Business rows and unsupported ownership claims out of an owner-confirmed branch.

workflow.label: Published-phone reuse gate
workflow.detail: Treat Phone_No as a business-contact candidate only. Hold absent, shared, or over-threshold phone values before verification.

workflow.label: Hold absent or shared contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer or append a private number, and do not call a shared office or answering-service line a direct owner contact.

workflow.label: Contact and owner-evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require independent owner evidence plus line-type, live, DNC, suppression, and delivery-dedupe checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed evidence
workflow.detail: Keep non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, DNC, or owner-unconfirmed cases out of owner-confirmed delivery.

workflow.label: Deliver supported contact
workflow.detail: Deliver only when every permitted-contact and independent owner-evidence gate passes.

movers_tree_haulers.title: Movers, tree services, and haulers business-contact review
movers_tree_haulers.hypothesis: An active FMCSA carrier row can establish a published business contact and a role-labeled identity candidate for a narrowly matched mover, truck-equipped tree-service, junk-removal, or hauling business. It does not establish that a local business is FMCSA-covered, that Company Officer 1 is the current owner, that the published number belongs to that person, or that the number is mobile, live, DNC-cleared, or deliverable.

workflow.detail: Do not turn cargo flags, a truck, or a broad name match into a mover, tree-service, or hauling classification.

workflow.detail: Keep the row from the micro-owner branch; do not infer scale from a title or phone.

workflow.label: Assess officer and entity evidence
workflow.detail: Retain Company Officer 1 with its entity type and legal-name comparison. An Individual row with a matching person may be a stronger candidate; an officer, corporation, partnership, or blank entity type is not owner confirmation.

workflow.label: Hold unsupported owner claim
workflow.detail: Keep officer identity provenance but do not label the person an owner or use any address to discover a private number.

workflow.label: Published carrier phone present?
workflow.detail: Use the published `cell_phone` preference or `phone` as business-contact evidence only; cell-field presence does not prove handset ownership.

workflow.label: Hold without eligible contact

workflow.label: Apply contact and compliance gates

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?

workflow.detail: Retain only the classification supported by evidence; no owner-confirmed mobile is emitted.

str_operator.title: Short-term-rental operator role and contact review
str_operator.hypothesis: An official STR permit establishes only a permit/license-holder or published permit-contact candidate. An owner-deliverable workflow requires separate current-owner evidence and an explicitly published business-contact fact; host, contact, manager, property owner, and license holder roles are not interchangeable.
str_operator.ownerSource: NOLA and Orlando STR registers publish permit/license-holder and contact-related fields, but neither implemented parser records independent evidence that a named person currently owns the operating STR business.
str_operator.phoneSource: The NOLA contact_phone and Orlando license_holder_phone fields are publicly published permit fields. The reviewed catalog/schema does not establish that every such field is an explicitly published business contact or that it belongs to the business owner; property-owner addresses and private-contact enrichment are excluded.

workflow.label: Official STR permit row
workflow.detail: Read only the public NOLA or Orlando permit/license row and its published fields. Do not use a property-owner address, parcel, residence, or private-phone lookup.

workflow.label: Current issued/active status?
workflow.detail: NOLA must be Issued and Orlando Active. A pending, closed, inactive, or other status is not a deliverable operating record.

workflow.label: Hold noncurrent permit
workflow.detail: Keep pending or non-active rows as non-deliverable source evidence.

workflow.label: Holder and contact roles align?
workflow.detail: Retain permit contact, license holder, and property-owner roles separately. A differing contact may be a manager or co-host and cannot replace the holder as owner identity.

workflow.label: Hold manager/contact-only role
workflow.detail: Do not call a contact, host, manager, property owner, or entity representative the operating business owner from role text alone.

workflow.label: Permit-holder candidate
workflow.detail: An issued/active person holder or aligned permit contact is an identity candidate only; it does not prove business ownership or handset relationship.

workflow.label: Explicit published business contact?
workflow.detail: Require affirmative source evidence that the phone is published for business contact. A public permit phone or a mobile classification alone is insufficient.

workflow.label: Hold nonbusiness or unknown contact
workflow.detail: Do not use a personal/residential contact, property address, skip trace, append, or phone lookup to create business-contact evidence.

workflow.label: Current owner relationship supported?
workflow.detail: Require independent, current evidence that the candidate owns the operating STR business; a license/permit-holder field alone does not satisfy this gate.

workflow.label: Hold owner-unconfirmed candidate
workflow.detail: Keep candidate-only, host, manager, and unresolved license-holder rows out of owner delivery.

workflow.label: Verify contact and compliance
workflow.detail: After both role gates pass, record line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, freshness, and handset relationship independently.

workflow.label: Hold failed verification
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, stale, or otherwise unsupported records.

workflow.label: Deliver supported owner classification
workflow.detail: Only current ownership, explicit business-contact publication, and all verification/compliance gates support owner delivery.
